verdict.rationale: Edge0's source is publicly readable on GitHub: the repo exposes scripts (fetch_models.py), examples (bench.py), a pytest unit-test suite, and a modular backend layout with a reserved `backends/cuda/` slot. Nothing in the evidence names the license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unverified. Missing for 10: any stated license (e.g. an OSI-approved LICENSE file), and confirmation that the platform apps (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS) and native engines are also published as source.
